Festive field of the Phoenicians, who come back triumphant from the expedition, which to Isseus was committed to reduce to obedience the rebellious kingdom of Cyprus. All the Cavalry is arranged on the sides, and of prospect at the bottom. In greater distance the chariots are seen, which accompany the Army. Timpani, and trumpets to the right, and to the left. From the center of the field between glorious trophies is crossed Isseus on horseback, preceded by the greater Dukes of the hosts, and followed by the Prisoners of Cyprus. Isseus; and Semele on the throne.
